Each row is assembled from aggregates in one pass: worst open issue, open-issue count, overdue work, decisions awaiting review, stale sources, delivery lead, next commitment and linked evidence. `healthReasons` is the transparent reason list behind the row — there is no hidden composite health number. `highestLatestProjectScore` is the highest `scoreTotal` among this client's projects' MOST RECENT reports — the highest latest project score, NOT an aggregate client-health score. prompts.description: For aeo-audit: prompts in the matrix (this is the matrix tier size).

runCount.description: For aeo-audit: repeats per prompt. The AEO module enforces a floor of 5.

markets.description: For aeo-audit: markets the run covers (>= 1).

requestedConfiguration.description: The requested configuration, echoed back verbatim in the response so the estimate can be tied to the exact parameters it was priced for.

checkProviderBalance.description: Ask the provider for its current balance. Off by default so a dry estimate makes no network call. When on and the balance cannot be read, the response reports affordability "unknown" with the reason — never "affordable".

provider.description: Provider id (cloro, dataforseo, anthropic, openrouter, apify, psi, …).

unit.description: usd or credits — never both, never summed.

reservationId.description: The reservation this settles against. Required when there is no jobRunId.

jobRunId.description: The G07 run that incurred it. Required when there is no reservationId.

quantity.description: How many units of work were bought.

occurredAt.description: When the charge occurred. Defaults to now.

taskKind.description: The work this reservation is for.

jobRunId.description: The G07 run this reservation belongs to, when there is one.

estimateLowUsd.description: Low end of the estimate, in USD.

estimateHighUsd.description: High end of the estimate, in USD. This is what the per-run cap is checked against.

reservedUsd.description: USD to set aside. Defaults to the high estimate.

reservedCredits.description: Credits to set aside. Credits are never converted into reservedUsd — a credit ceiling is checked against credit reservations only.

provider.description: Provider the spend will go to (cloro, dataforseo, anthropic, openrouter, apify, psi, …). Recorded on the settlement event.

ttlMinutes.description: Minutes the hold lives before it lapses. An expired hold stops counting against the ceiling — a crashed run must not block the next one forever.

reason.description: Why this hold is being given back, e.g. "run cancelled before the provider was called".

settledUsd.description: The actual USD charge. Defaults to the reserved USD when the provider does not report one — but a defaulted figure is labelled as such in the response.

settledCredits.description: The actual credit charge, from the provider response (e.g. Cloro creditsCharged).

provider.description: Provider the charge came from. Falls back to the reservation request, then "unknown".

quantity.description: How many units of work were bought (requests, prompts, pages, tokens).

note.description: Short audit note recorded on the spend event.

acknowledgeOverReservation.description: Settle even though the charge exceeded the reserved amount. Without it, an over-reservation settlement is refused (409) so an unbounded overrun is a decision, not an accident.

filters.description: The filter/sort/column query state — stored verbatim, never a snapshot of result rows.

code.description: Stable slug quoted in checkout metadata, e.g. `monitoring-monthly`.

providerPriceId.description: Provider price id (`price_...`). The second server-side mapping key after `code`.

amountCents.description: List price in minor units. Never taken from a caller on the public surface.

entitlements.description: Entitlement keys this offer grants once payment is verified. Granted from the event, never from a browser.

reason.description: Why it is being revoked. Recorded on the audit trail, not on the row.

domain.description: The site to diagnose. A URL or bare host is normalized to its canonical host.

goal.description: What the requester is trying to achieve — the operator's first question.

consent.description: Must be exactly `true`. Records that the sender agreed to Cailyx contacting them about this request at the address given.

challengeToken.description: Token from GET /api/public/diagnostic-challenge. Signed, expiring, single-use.

challengeAnswer.description: The solution to the challenge: any string whose SHA-256 with the token has the required leading zero bits.

email.description: Supplying an email creates/updates the lead. Requires `consent: true`.

meta.description: Small non-secret context (page, campaign). Capped at 2 KB serialized.

sections.description: Sections to include. Defaults to the documented bundle, which deliberately excludes `leads` (Cailyx's own sales pipeline, personal contact data) and `activity` (the audit trail). Both are exportable on request — nothing is silently included.

format.description: `json` writes one bundle for all requested sections. `csv` renders exactly one section as CSV — a bundle cannot be represented in a spreadsheet, and this service does not invent an archive format it cannot produce.

ttlHours.description: Download-link lifetime in hours (1-168, default 24). An export is scoped and expiring, not a permalink.

reason.description: Why this export was requested. Recorded on the row and in the audit trail.

retainDays.description: Retention window in days. Null means "no window" — the policy never matches anything, which is different from a window of 0.

action.description: What the policy does to rows older than the window. `delete` is refused for `activity`: the audit trail is retained under policy.

enabled.description: Whether the policy runs. A disabled policy is still a stored intention, and is reported as disabled rather than absent.

confirm.description: Must be literally true. The apply refuses without it, so a destructive run is never the default reading of a request.

reason.description: Why this retention run was applied. Recorded on the audit event.

shareLinkPolicy.description: What happens to public report links. `revoke` stamps `revokedAt` and makes the reports private again; `keep` leaves them live and says so. `keep` is not the default because retaining a public link past offboarding is the one effect a client cannot undo.

overrides.description: Per-resource-type action overrides, e.g. `{ "observations": "delete", "client-messages": "delete" }`. Only resource types whose policy is overridable accept one, and only for an action the policy lists — an override for the audit trail or for a credential is refused rather than ignored.

classes.description: Narrow the preview to these classes. Omitted means every class — the preview is never narrowed for the caller by default, because an unreported cascade is the failure this endpoint exists to prevent.

previewRunId.description: The OffboardingRun id returned by the preview. Its counts are re-verified at execute time; if the client's data moved since, the execute is refused (409) and a fresh preview is required.

confirm.description: Must be literally true. The execute refuses without it.

confirmationPhrase.description: The client's exact name, typed out. Mismatches are refused (400).

shareLinkPolicy.description: Overrides the preview's choice. The applied policy is recorded on the run and reported back.

exportRequestId.description: An already-ready ExportRequest covering this client, recorded on the run as the copy taken before destruction. Not required — but if it is named, it must be a ready export for this same client.

acknowledgeFrozenSnapshots.description: Required only when the plan would delete rows that a pinned EvidenceManifest names. The preview reports those conflicts by id; a frozen snapshot whose sources are removed can no longer be resolved, so the acknowledgement is explicit.

reason.description: Why the plan was abandoned. Recorded on the run.

displayName.description: Shown in the app chrome and on released documents.

logoUrl.description: Absolute URL to the logo used on released documents. Send `null` to clear a previously set logo.

primaryColor.description: Hex colour applied as a CSS custom property override. Validated as hex — named colours and rgb()/hsl() are refused. Send `null` to clear it and fall back to the application default.

timezone.description: IANA zone. Validated against Intl, not a hard-coded list.

defaultTier.description: Default service tier for a new engagement.

reviewSlaHours.description: Hours a review is expected to take.

allowPublicShare.description: Whether operators may create anyone-with-the-link report shares. This is a policy switch other modules consult before minting a share link — it is not a UI toggle.

key.description: Stable key the renderer switches on.

include.description: False keeps the section configured but out of the document.

isDefault.description: Make this the template in force for its report type. Setting it clears the previous default of the same type.

role.description: Role name, or a ClientMember/User id once applied.

offsetDays.description: Days from the apply date. Only becomes a due date when the apply call supplies `startOn`.

projectId.description: Project the rows are copied into.

cycleId.description: Required for a `cycle` template: the cycle the copied work items go into. A committed cycle also requires `scopeChangeReason` — the copy cannot silently change a frozen scope denominator.

scopeChangeReason.description: Required when `cycleId` is an already-committed cycle. Recorded in Cycle.scopeChanges.

startOn.description: Date the schedule is measured from, for `offsetDays`. When omitted, NO due dates are set — a template cannot invent a start date it was not given.

dryRun.description: Report what would be copied without writing anything.

reason.description: Recorded in the audit trail alongside the copy.
